record.label: Factorized Gaussian degree-8/10 path shells
record.summary: The exact repeated-slice quotients for D8 paths (1,3,4)/(2,2,4) and D10 paths (1,4,5)/(2,3,5) were verified and replayed once. No arm is adjusted-positive. Best raw-only D8(1,3,4) reaches 2.856564055e-8 but projects 1.211016554e-8 adjusted; the cheapest adjusted arm D8(2,2,4) worsens raw and projects 1.194382394e-8. The D6+D8+D10 stack reaches raw 2.854023125e-8 but projects 1.243842515e-8. Dense triangle sectors require at least 13.194T added FLOPs and are cost-closed.
record.terminal_criterion: Closed for every factorized connected D8/D10 path quotient and their fixed D6 stack by the frozen rank-0 adjusted breakeven; the remaining dense triangles are closed by their literal lower-bound bill.
